title: Florida House, District 108
what_it_does: Represents District 108 (Part of Miami-Dade) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Wancito Francius
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.background: Wancito Francius, 50, is a lifelong North Miami resident with a bachelor's degree in criminal justice who describes himself as an entrepreneur and activist. He has run for the Legislature several times, including as a Democrat in 2022 and 2024, and is now the Republican nominee. His signature proposal is an $8 million autism support act named for his son.

housing.summary: Francius supports protecting dedicated housing funds, expanding first-time homebuyer help, public-private workforce housing and rental-fee transparency.

candidates.name: Daphne Campbell
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Registered nurse; former state representative (2010-2016) and state senator
candidates.background: Daphne Campbell, 69, is a registered nurse born in Cap-Haïtien, Haiti, who served three terms in the Florida House and one in the Senate before losing a 2018 primary. She won the August 2026 Democratic primary in this heavily Democratic northeast Miami-Dade district.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

housing.summary: Campbell says housing is a necessity, pledges to protect the Sadowski housing trust funds and supports first-time homebuyer, rental-assistance and workforce-housing programs.
housing.quote: Housing is not a privilege. It is a necessity.

sources.title: The Miami Times: Florida House District 108: Meet the Democratic candidates seeking to succeed Dotie Joseph
Vote411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Daphne Campbell

abortion.summary: She says she supports protecting unborn life with exceptions for the mother's life, rape, incest and nonviable pregnancies.
abortion.quote: I support protecting unborn life while recognizing that certain circumstances involve deeply difficult medical and personal realities

healthcare.summary: A nurse of more than 45 years, she calls health care a basic necessity and supports expanding state-supported coverage options and reducing enrollment barriers.
